rules.R1: primary language Python, JavaScript or TypeScript
rules.R2: 100 to 3,000 stars; not archived; not a fork; MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause or ISC
rules.R3: order by SHA-256 of seed + newline + lower-case full name
rules.R5: at least 150 tracked non-test source files at the base commit
rules.R6: install recipe from the fixed list applies at the base commit
rules.T1: merged into the default branch on or after 2026-07-31; issue opened on or after 2026-07-01
rules.T2: linked same-repository issue (closing keyword or closingIssuesReferences) with >= 20 prose words, not reused
rules.T3: fix shape: >= 2 non-test code files or >= 25 code lines; <= 8 files, <= 400 lines; >= 1 code test file; no dependency or binary code change
rules.T4: issue title and body name no fixed non-test code file (path or whole-token file name)
rules.T5: Docker: 3/3 fail before, 3/3 pass after, 300 s, no network; isolation probe; the real fix graded solved by the scoring grader (grade.sh, protection on); a repository stops after 3 T5 rejections in a row
rules.T6: at most 2 tasks per repository; at least 8 repositories

parameters.gold_grade: the real fix graded by grade.sh with protection on, test limit 600 s

t4_share.definition: candidates whose first failing rule is not T1, T2 or T3 (accepted included)

selection.pool_order: order of acceptance in the walk (repository key order, then newest merge first)
